# 28. Communication Channels

## 28.2 Taxonomy and axes

The adapter opens the stray-token connection to the runtime, which is a
reference to the channel rather than a declaration of its spelling.

## 28.3 Registers

| Channel | Carrier | Retired spelling | Canonical spelling |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `CH-SAMPLE` | `socket` | `sample-token` | `specimen-token` |
| `CH-STRAY` | `socket` | `stray-token` | `wander-token` |
